translation.name: Mokro Garden
translation.summary: A plant-filled cafe near Seoul Forest serving coffee, tea and vegan or gluten-free desserts.
translation.description: Mokro Garden combines a cafe with a gardening-oriented interior filled with plants and flowers. It is a calmer option near Seoul Forest and can work well for travelers looking for plant-based or gluten-free dessert choices.
translation.local_tip: Use this as a quieter Seoul Forest-side stop before heading toward the busier streets around Seongsu Station.
